title: Student-Facing Collection View
subtitle: A dynamic portal for students to explore their learning journey.
key_concept: Personalized learning path with visible gaps.
visual_metaphor: A cathedral nave with stained glass windows, each window representing a category, with some panes dark (gaps) and others illuminated (collected), a progress bar as the altar rail.
why_it_matters: Introduced a student-facing interface that visualizes learning progress and motivates through visible gaps.
zone_change: New territory: Student Experience — from admin tools to learner-facing portal.
